Theorem 1's bound also provides little quantitative support at the experimental settings: with beta=20, reward bound 1, chi-squared divergence 2, and epsilon=0.1, it requires approximately 6.7e18 candidates, versus at most 256 experimentally. Appendix C.5's favorable numerical illustration instead uses beta=1.

Reproducibility remains incomplete in the supplied manuscript: the implementation and reproducibility statements contain no code URL. Appendix B.2 additionally introduces an early-abort rule when all draft rewards fall below 0.1, which is absent from Algorithm 1; its application across baselines and its effect on latency and accuracy are not established. Evaluation with one PRM and two closely related Qwen families also limits evidence for broader robustness.
